title: Cross-database external validation
summary: Candidate coordinates for transporting a locked ICU analysis or prediction model across databases. Harmonization must preserve concept meaning, time zero, eligibility, outcome horizon, units, and missingness provenance rather than forcing superficial column alignment.

design_candidates.population: A source population and one or more independently sampled target-database populations mapped to a common, clinically defensible eligibility definition.
design_candidates.time_zero: The same clinical landmark in every database, with any implementation differences documented.
design_candidates.observation_window: Semantically equivalent pre-landmark variables, units, aggregation rules, and missingness states in each database.
design_candidates.prediction_or_followup_window: A consistently ascertainable outcome horizon; database-specific approximations must be labeled and tested.
eligibility_candidates: Lock the source model or analysis before target evaluation
Audit concept and unit equivalence before pooling
design_candidates.exposure: The locked source model, score, exposure definition, or analysis specification applied without target-outcome-guided redesign.
design_candidates.outcome: A harmonized outcome with equivalent horizon and ascertainment, plus database-specific limitations.
design_candidates.estimand: Target-database performance or effect estimate, with heterogeneity and transportability described rather than obscured by pooling.

stop_conditions: Time zero or outcome horizon is not meaningfully harmonizable
The source specification was modified using target outcomes without labeling redevelopment
Required concepts have incompatible clinical meaning across databases
